America.title: Power outage in DC's Foggy Bottom
America.summary: Pepco said an event at its I Street Substation left about 1,100 customers without power, and outage maps listed 1,176. The area is blocks from the White House, and traffic lights and some federal facilities were affected. Firefighters responded to smoke from multiple manholes, and a manhole explosion was reported outside the World Bank.
America.status: Restoration status and cause not confirmed in the cited posts

America.title: Flash flooding in Brevard County, Florida
America.location: Brevard and Indian River Counties, FL
America.summary: NWS Melbourne reports 16 to 22 inches of rain, with 1 to 2 more inches possible. At 2 PM ET the Flash Flood Emergency for southern Brevard was lowered to a Considerable Flash Flood Warning, and a Flood Warning is in effect until 9:30 PM ET. Florida's Division of Emergency Management is deploying flood pumps to Central and South Florida.
America.status: Official warnings in effect; flooding impacts continue

America.title: Two Maricopa County vote centers briefly closed over power issues
America.location: Paradise Community College and Sunset Canyon School vote centers, Maricopa County, AZ
America.summary: Maricopa County Elections said the vote centers at Paradise Community College and Sunset Canyon School were temporarily closed because of power-related issues (an earlier version of the post said storm-related) and sent voters to nearby locations. The closure was posted at about 10:57 AM ET on Nov 2, the day before the Nov 3 General Election. The county said both centers were open again at about 1:25 PM ET. Online claims of fraud or targeting have no official confirmation.
America.status: Resolved; both vote centers reopened per Maricopa County Elections

Europe.title: Second wave of cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration
Europe.location: At least seven European countries, including Belgium and Sweden
Europe.summary: Grocery stores in at least seven European countries saw refrigerator temperatures soar on Monday, and several confirmed a cyberattack similar to one in France three weeks ago. In Belgium, about 40 stores across Delhaize, Carrefour, Spa and other chains were hit, with about €100,000 of food thrown away.
Europe.status: Confirmed by several companies; attribution unknown

Europe.title: Violent cost-of-living and anti-government protests
Europe.summary: On Oct 31, masked rioters looted shops in Frankfurt, and German police fired water cannons at youths throwing Molotov cocktails. In Paris and elsewhere in France, police fired tear gas as hundreds of thousands marched against living costs and police violence. In Tirana, protesters threw Molotov cocktails and paving stones at police.
Europe.status: Confirmed by major outlets; further marches possible

Europe.title: Spyware alerts for German officials
Europe.summary: People who received the alerts were told to treat their phones as compromised. It is not yet known who is behind the attack or how many people were affected.

Europe.title: London–Bulgaria flight diverted after bomb threat
Europe.summary: A plane flying from London to Bulgaria was diverted to Budapest after a reported bomb threat. No further details were confirmed this run.

Europe.title: Island-wide blackout on La Palma
Europe.summary: A storm cut power across La Palma for about four hours, affecting more than 50,500 supply points. Power was restored at 10:26 local time.

Russia.title: Emergency alert apps in Ukraine and Russia hacked
Russia.summary: Ukraine and Russia both said their emergency alert apps had been hacked, sending false warnings about air raids and chemical and nuclear attacks. Russia said its app suffered a "massive cyberattack" on Monday, hours after Ukraine reported its own hack. In Ukraine the fake nuclear warning caused unease but not panic.
Russia.status: Officially confirmed by both governments; attribution unproven

Russia.title: Russian bombs kill 24 at aid point in Komyshuvakha
Russia.summary: Zelenskyy said aerial bombs hit the settlement several times starting in the morning, targeting a school where people were receiving humanitarian aid. The Kyiv Independent reports 24 killed.
Russia.status: Official statement issued; toll may rise

Russia.title: Ukrainian drone strike reported on Samara oil facility
Russia.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station in Prosvet overnight.
Russia.status: Reported by Ukrainian channels; no Russian confirmation seen

Middle East.title: Tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz
Middle East.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy says two tankers "exploded" after hitting mines in Hormuz. ADNOC's CEO said nearly one billion barrels have been drained from global inventories since the strait was disrupted.
Middle East.status: IRGC claim reported by Reuters; independent confirmation limited

Middle East.title: Reports the US is weighing renewed strikes on Iran
Middle East.summary: Reports say the US is weighing renewed strikes on Iran after the midterms, and Iran has warned of retaliation against US bases. A claim of an imminent US nuclear strike is unconfirmed.
Middle East.status: No strikes confirmed; from X News summaries, no X post linked

Middle East.title: Israeli operation around Hebron
Middle East.summary: Israel launched a large-scale operation around Hebron after a shooting attack killed two soldiers. Palestinians have returned home to survey the damage.

Africa.title: Johannesburg water crisis
Africa.summary: Residents and civic activists planned a protest outside Johannesburg Water's head office, and the Joburg Crisis Alliance is threatening legal action against the city over unreliable water supply. The mayor says intensified technical work is beginning to improve supply.

Africa.title: 'Tinubu Must Go' protests in Gusau
Africa.summary: Largely peaceful protests over insecurity and hardship were reported in Gusau.
Africa.status: From X News summaries; no X post linked

South America.title: Truck bomb near military base in Planadas, Colombia
South America.summary: A truck bomb detonated near a military base in Planadas, killing four people, including a two-month-old girl, an official said. The blast heavily damaged a hospital, a school and several homes.
South America.status: Confirmed by officials and major outlets; no claim of responsibility seen

trending.title: No emergency topic trending globally
trending.summary: Worldwide X trends are dominated by sports, Turkish politics and US Election Day.

threats.title: Linux kernel flaw CVE-2026-98432
threats.summary: The flaw remains unpatched on Ubuntu. Watch for exploitation.
threats.status: From X News summaries; no X post linked

threats.title: BTCPay Server hot wallets drained
threats.summary: About 18 BTC was reported drained from BTCPay Server hot wallets.
threats.status: From X News summaries; no X post linked

threats.title: Cyberattack at Spandana Sphoorty Financial
threats.summary: India's Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported a cyberattack involving its bank account.

threats.title: Unsupported 'coordinated attack' claims
threats.summary: Posts linking the DC outage, the EU fridge attacks and other outages as one coordinated event have no evidence. Treat them as separate incidents.
